name: leadfactory-oss
title_zh: 本地跑通的获客代理全套：23 个技能加客户驾驶舱
tagline_zh: 不用月付 SaaS，不把客户数据送进别人家后台。自带 onboard 流程和业务模板，从线索到报价单的活。
tagline_en: No monthly SaaS, no client data in someone else's cloud. Onboarding, business templates, and 23 skills—your whole.
desc_en: Open source lead generation agency: local client cockpit, onboarding, 23 skills, business processes and agent templates.
why_zh: 把代理公司整套作业流固化成代码：客户状态、技能调用、交付物模板全在一个驾驶舱里对齐。
why_en: Turns your agency's entire workflow into code: client states, skill calls, and deliverable templates align in one cockpit—new.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 lead-gen 代理的通用流程，不含行业专属话术或垂直数据源；需要自备邮件/CRM 的 API 密钥。
limit_en: Covers generic lead-gen agency flows only—no vertical-specific scripts or data sources. Needs your own email/CRM API keys; 23 skills are skeletons.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Local lead-gen agency kit: 23 skills + client cockpit
